messages:
Mia Chen: Quick design review — pushed an updated latency dashboard mock with p95 line, session heatmap, new micro time-range buttons, and a sampling slider. PTAL: https://figma-preview/redwood/latency-dashboard :eyes:

Julian Park: Looks solid overall. One immediate concern — the heatmap color ramp relies on hue only. Not great for colorblind users and low-contrast screens. Can we add texture/diagonal hatch option or a monotone + intensity ramp? :thinking:

Sasha Patel: Agree with Julian. Also the p95 tooltip needs to show sample size and the sampling rate used to compute it. Right now 'p95: 230ms' is ambiguous if sampling is applied.

Denis Kovač: Time-range microbuttons (1h / 6h / 24h) are handy, but we need clear keyboard focus states and aria-labels. Accessibility nit: the custom range input should support keyboard-only entry and a "last N minutes" shortcut.

Mia Chen: Good calls. For sampling controls — current mock sets default to 1%. From an evaluation perspective that's pretty noisy for tail metrics. UX suggestion: default at 5% with an inline recommendation. Any objections to 5%?

Julian Park: 5% is better for stability, but cost implications for high-volume orgs. What about 5% default with an 'auto-suggest' that bumps to 10% when traffic < X rps? Also show an inline estimate: "Estimated tokens/month: 120k" so users can reason about cost.

Sasha Patel: Copy tweak: change label from "Sampling rate" to "Trace sampling" and helper text to "Lower sampling reduces cost but increases variance in p95/throughput estimates. Use higher sampling for incident investigations." Add a link to docs.

ops-bot: deploy-preview: latency-dashboard/v3 available at https://deploy-preview.redwood/latency-dashboard (screenshots + interactive)

Mia Chen: Thanks — I'll iterate the mock: add hatch option for heatmap, include sample-size tooltip, and wire up keyboard states. Figma file updated: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (version 4). I'll also add an aria example in the prototype: ```<button aria-label="Last 1 hour" data-shortcut="1">1h</button>```

Denis Kovač: NIT: heatmap legend spacing — make the ticks evenly distributed and add faint gridlines so small-screen heatmaps retain readability. On mobile the legend should collapse into a single icon with tap-to-expand.

Julian Park: :thumbsup: Solid plan. Action items: @Mia update mocks and prototype a11y interactions, @Sasha finalize copy + docs link, @Denis produce a short accessibility checklist for the component. I'll schedule a 15min sync tomorrow 9:00am PT to review final screens.

Mia Chen: Sounds good — will have updated frames before the sync. Thanks everyone!
